nodes.label: Next.js Logo SVG
nodes.rationale: Vector wordmark spelling 'NEXT.JS' (black fill, 394x80 viewBox). Includes the trademark Next.js 'N' glyph with diagonal slash (the zigzag path) followed by letterforms N-E-X-T-J-S drawn as filled path outlines. Serves as the project's Next.js framework branding asset in /public, typically displayed on the app's start page.
